channel_intelligence.suno_rules: Data-backed prompt rules, updated 2026-09-21: (1) ALWAYS 'instrumental / no vocals'. (2) KEEP ENERGY CONSISTENT, no dynamic spikes - Suggested sessions are the watch-time source (413 of 524 minutes this week) and they end the moment a track jumps. (3) WRITE 120/150/180-MINUTE SETS AND VARY THE RUNTIME - longs are 98% of this week's watch minutes; eight identical 1:17:43 uploads got 34 views combined. (4) NEW - SEASON THE PROMPT AND THE TITLE. The one long YouTube distributed this month was titled 'Cozy Autumn Ambience' and was suggested beside autumn-jazz videos; write the season into the mood ('cozy autumn cafe', 'rainy fall morning') so the audio matches the title it will be shelved under. (5) FUN/UPBEAT OVER SOFT/SLEEPY ON LONG-FORM WATCH MINUTES - 839 vs 564 per long; but on REELS the opposite: Fun Bossa clips halved Shorts views vs Piano Trio (n=1 week). Score long prompts on minutes, reel clips on engaged views. (6) AVOID SOFT JAZZ REAL GUITAR - 210 min/long. (7) NAME THE ACTION AND MATCH SEARCH - 'bossa nova cafe', 'slow bossa nova', 'slow morning music' are the queries that reach longs. (8) WITHDRAWN - caption rules; captions are noise on 5 weeks of data.
